description: TIP-013 Phase A representative answer-quality eval set (AC-A4). Synthetic-by-construction, covering fact-lookup, honest-null, cross-version/freshness, ACL-restricted (V2 MUST refuse — any leak is P0), verification gating, and research-vs-SOT labelling. The runner seeds each fixture through the real publish/import gates, asks V2, and the pure scorer emits grounded-rate, honest-null-quality, leak-count (must be 0) and citation-accuracy. Real-corpus re-baseline is Phase B (D-013-05).
